smartcrop.js 2.0.5, MIT, Jonas Wagner.

Unmodified. Content-aware cropping, used by the `stream-cards` feature as the
fallback when MediaPipe (`../mediapipe/`) finds no face in a portrait. No build
step or runtime network dependency.

Retain LICENSE.md when updating; do not edit the upstream file.
